name: Native-schedule value-only local ToMe consolidation
scope: training-free accuracy hypothesis; no speed or token-count improvement claim
mechanism: Pinned official ToMe bipartite assignment, weighted mean and unmerge on each4x4 past-frame window; consolidate4of16 tokens then re-expand V. Original post-RoPE K,Q,pointer tail and conditioning map stay exact. Native six-map schedule, temporal table, memory-write function and decoder unchanged.
role_labels: No foreground/background/boundary partitions used in matching or quota
prior_work_distinction: Previous wider-history ToMe changed history coverage and K/V. Earlier value-only shadow measured attention errors but not a deployable native-schedule module or full-video efficacy. Trained value adapters are different.
known_risks: Value smoothing can remove useful detail and still cause feedback drift
Preserving K preserves retrieval weights, not necessarily correct retrieval or better Dice
No efficiency benefit; this tests segmentation behavior, not compression speed
required_gate: Q,K,pointers and conditioning exact in value-only mode
unchanged parameters and banks; no writes
stopping_rule: Any invariant failure prevents broader inference. Do not run efficacy before real-frame gate and separately frozen meaningful-gain comparison. Do not tune quarter-merging or window size from these outcomes.
test_result: 12 focused tests;4real targets×4layers×2processes exact replay; no efficacy result
